summary: Ran backend pytest and full public-URL UI/integration regression for responsive header, auth guards, admin tabs, checkout/order flows, WhatsApp tracking, and archive behavior.

ui_bugs.issue: Expected inline validation errors did not render for empty submit in automated run (browser-native validation may block React error rendering path).

integration_issues.issue: ExchangeRate API fetch failed in browser logs and app fell back to local fallback rates.

action_items: Investigate checkout validation UX so required/invalid submissions consistently show intended inline error messages.
Stabilize currency API availability or improve observable fallback messaging for operators.
Add test-visible error states (data-testid/alert hooks) for admin tracking/status mutation failures to make runtime security-rule verification deterministic.
critical_code_review_comments: Admin.tsx is 1500+ lines and exceeds maintainability guideline (>700); split into focused modules.
Security/business rule checks are correctly enforced server-side in Convex code: server-priced checkout/stock checks, tracking URL validation, and order status allowlist.
Product archive semantics are correctly implemented as soft-hide (is_active=false) rather than hard delete.
seed_data_creation: Created customer buyer1778229500@example.com with password123, placed MOCKED order HE-29498005, and archived product 'green kufi' during archive behavior test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified on public URL: header alignment passed at desktop/tablet/mobile; admin guard/login passed; admin tabs/products/inventory/fulfillment/settings rendered; WhatsApp send opened WhatsApp web URL for phone-backed order; checkout->order confirmation->track order->account regression passed; archive hides product from storefront search. Runtime rejection feedback for invalid tracking URL/status was not visibly surfaced via current selectors.
rca of the issue: RCA-1 (validation visibility): Checkout relies on required/type constraints plus React validation; browser-native form blocking can prevent expected inline React errors from appearing in automation. RCA-2 (currency integration): External ExchangeRate API request intermittently fails in this environment; app degrades to fallback rates by design. RCA-3 (security verification observability): Admin mutation failures (invalid tracking URL/status) are validated server-side in convex/orders.ts but UI lacks deterministic, test-targetable error surfacing for those rejected writes.
